judgments.reason: The model text describes the auction commission as given to the auction winner after paying the bid, but does not claim or demonstrate that bids above available coins are allowed because commission is applied before payment. No articulated mechanism explains bidding beyond coin limits.

The specification asserts that waiting lets you see rivals' committed bids before committing your own. The model never articulates using wait to observe rivals prior to committing; instead the focal player had already committed and then observed a revealed rival bid. The mechanism (revealing sealed bids before you commit) is not explained.

The claim of early settlement (close settling with unauctioned lots) is not articulated or demonstrated in the model text or transcript. The model never describes or shows an actual early settlement mechanism or outcome.

The model explicitly states the three-coin commission applies to the auction winner and that catalog buys are not auction wins. It does not articulate any mechanism where catalog purchases receive the auction commission.
